changes: Seven real-file test functions cover 100 identical claims, changed migration bytes, process ownership, pre-commit kill, post-commit abrupt exit, busy lock recovery and WAL reader snapshot isolation. Four further real-file type conversion tests cover timestamps, signed integer limits, canonical JSON, scope paths and decimal precision.
case_scope: Partial local evidence for TX-01, TX-06, TX-07, TX-08, TX-11 and SQLITE-07; no full-case PASS claimed. Partial local evidence for SQLITE-02.
remaining: Complete A00/A01 and the remaining SQLITE/TX acceptance scenarios, including command readback across actual crash, checksum crash/replay, busy snapshot, disk-full, fsync, WAL retention and external cases.
